args: set -euo pipefail; export DSH_HOME=$(mktemp -d); p="$PWD/adapters/dsh"; npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2 --profile tdcheck --from-default-profile headless --dump-config > /dev/null; npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2 plugin --profile tdcheck add "$p"; out=$(npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2 --profile tdcheck --patch "$p/cordis.patch.yml" --dump-config); echo "$out" | grep -q dsh-tier-drop; echo "$out" | grep -q mcp-tier-drop

evidence_required: Output of pnpm install and pnpm check.
The dump-config excerpt showing dsh-tier-drop and mcp-tier-drop.
objective: Build the strict TypeScript Cordis plugin that calls the tier-drop CLI, the Cordis patch that mounts it and the hosted MCP, and the Pi description, verified in an isolated DSH_HOME.

outputs.purpose: Cordis plugin registering the five tools.
Patch rows for the native plugin and the hosted MCP mount.
Install steps and the Verified section.
Node test with a fake ctx over the real CLI.
Adapters overview with the Pi section (R-43).

risk_controls: The isolated DSH_HOME is a temporary directory; ~/.dsh is never touched.
Ledger, registry and policy paths come only from trusted plugin config, never from tool arguments.
Rust by default; strict TypeScript only in adapters/dsh; no Python and no authored .js, .mjs or .cjs files.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's forbidden organisation name (grep pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden phrase (grep pattern needs[ ]you); plain, specific prose.
Work only in the slice's worktree and branch; never touch main.
rollback: Revert the branch; the temporary DSH_HOME is deleted.
steps: adapters/dsh/package.json (name: dsh-tier-drop, private: true, type: module, engines.node >= 24, packageManager: pnpm), peer deps pinned to the installed dsh: @deepseek-ai/cordis 4.0.2, @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 0.1.6-alpha.2, @deepseek-ai/schemastery; dsh.bundle.patch: ./cordis.patch.yml; scripts build (tsc), typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test (node --test tests/*.test.ts), check.
tsconfig.json strict (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, module: NodeNext), rootDir: src, outDir: dist.

src/index.ts: name, inject = ['tools'], Config via schemastery (binary, ledgerDir, registryPath, policyPath?, timeoutMs?), apply(ctx, config) registering the five tools with defineTool; a runCli(args, stdin, signal) helper with execFile (no shell), timeout, maxBuffer 8 MiB, JSON parse of stdout, error → { ok: false, error: { code, message } }; tool arguments are validated and may not carry paths.

cordis.patch.yml with the two rows (native plugin and mcp-tier-drop streamable-http mount); README.md with install steps (CLI install, pnpm install && pnpm build, dsh plugin --profile

add , patch rows, skill symlink) and the Pi section (R-43).

tests/plugin.test.ts: a fake ctx with tools.register capturing definitions; point binary at the real tier-drop built by cargo build -p tier-drop-cli (../../target/debug/tier-drop) and run tier_drop_plan over a temporary ledger; assert five registrations and the plan's kind.

Isolated dsh composition check (R-41): export DSH_HOME=$(mktemp -d); npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2 --profile tdcheck --from-default-profile headless --dump-config to initialise; npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.2 plugin --profile tdcheck add <absolute path to adapters/dsh>; npx … --profile tdcheck --patch <absolute path to adapters/dsh/cordis.patch.yml> --dump-config; confirm both rows appear resolved. Record the exact commands and output in adapters/dsh/README.md under "Verified". Do not touch ~/.dsh.
If S-06 is not yet merged, use the planned URL and update after.
